source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: During your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), if the **Lifta-droppa** of this unit destroys an enemy **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** model that has [Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise), that model’s [Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise) triggers on a 3+ instead of only on a 6.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

trigger.event: this unit's Lifta-droppa destroys an enemy model with Deadly Demise
